clips.title: The story
paras: In Booty Bay, the search for Velinde Starsong turns north toward Darkshire. Caravaneer Ruzzgot remembers the missing night elf priestess traveling with his caravan through Stranglethorn Vale.

Caravaneer Ruzzgot remembers Velinde Starsong as a passenger on his caravan. The search for the missing night elf priestess has brought you from Ashenvale to Booty Bay, at the southern edge of Stranglethorn Vale. She traveled with his caravan through the jungle, an unusual journey for a night elf priestess.

Ruzzgot says he and Velinde parted ways as they traveled north through Stranglethorn Vale. She set out toward Duskwood, and her trail leads to Darkshire. Clerk Daltry keeps the town's records, including the names of unfamiliar travelers who enter. His ledger may hold the next clue to Velinde's whereabouts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Turns out I was wrong about you, and that isn't something that happens everyday.

It just so happens that I remember this Velinde you're looking for. Isn't every day that a night elf priestess that wants to travel with a dirty old—but great for your shipping needs!--caravan like my own.
We split up on the way north, she was headed for Darkshire. The clerk there keeps all sorts of records. Might know something useful.
Be careful in the jungle, it is a deadly place even at the best of times.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With all the strange happenings of the last few years, I keep as good records of strangers as I can. Never know when it might come in handy... Though it's usually not pleasant business when it does. Not to suggest anything about this Velinde you're looking for.
